entities.name: UPF0102 YraN
observations: Small 131-residue bacterial protein; exact sequence match to reviewed Salmonella YraN entry B5F6R8.
Contains UPF0102 Pfam domain PF02021.24 spanning residues 24–114 with i-Evalue 1.1e-25.
Reviewed homolog annotation assigns nucleic acid binding (GO:0003676; ECO:0000501).
Predicted molecular weight is 14.88 kDa and theoretical pI is 9.68, consistent with a basic nucleic-acid-associated protein.
No catalytic activity, cofactor, membrane topology, or localization annotation was established by the sequence analysis.

entities.name: Nucleic acid binding
observations: GO:0003676 is assigned to reviewed UPF0102/YraN homologs, but the specific nucleic-acid substrate and mechanism are not resolved.
